source_text.body:
Search coworkers' agent session logs
An engineer wrote a skill to grep their own agent session logs, then wanted to search coworkers' agent logs as well.
·
Nov 21, 2026
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
Austin wrote a skill that greps the agent session logs stored on his own disk. It worked well. Coworkers then kept asking him to search for them, so he ran the skill himself and copy/pasted the results back to them.
How it went
The personal skill worked pretty well. The coworker case stayed manual and he wished he could search coworkers' logs directly. The post describes no solution and gives no numbers.
Worth knowing
The post is a short description of the problem. It has no implementation details, and it doesn't cover how to share logs across a team.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Code
Copy prompt
I have a skill/script that greps my own agent session logs stored at [path]. Extend it so it can also search my coworkers' agent session logs stored at [shared path or location], letting me filter by keyword, date, or person, and show me the results in a readable format. Test it on a sample query before I rely on it.
Original source: https://bsky.app/profile/thebadcode.com/post/3n2rs7u7aak2w
